scanNote:
WORKBOOK 5-UNITNING BIRINChI BETI (22-bet). Yuqorida to'q sariq yorliqda 'UNIT 5', yonida katta qora 'Planning Ahead'.

CHAP USTUN - 'Vocabulary':
1) 'Look at the pictures, then use words from the list below to fill in the gaps.' Qiya: 'plumber, hairdresser, secretary, photographer, artist, carpenter'. 6 RASM: a kompyuter; b arra; c gayka kaliti; d palitra va mo'yqalamlar; e taroq; f fotoapparat. a A(n) ...... uses a computer. b A(n) ...... uses a saw. c A(n) ...... uses a spanner. d A(n) ...... uses a palette and paintbrushes. e A(n) ...... uses a comb. f A(n) ...... uses a camera.
2) 'Match the jobs to the responsibilities, then make complete sentences, as in the example.' JADVAL JOBS / RESPONSIBILITIES: mechanic, farmer, chef, nurse, disc jockey, architect, plumber | prepares meals in a restaurant, plays songs on the radio, repairs cars, designs buildings, grows crops and raises animals, fixes leaking taps, looks after patients in a hospital. Strelka: mechanic → repairs cars. Qiya namuna: '...A mechanic repairs cars....' 5 ta bo'sh qator.

O'NG USTUN:
3) 'Use adjectives from the list to make sentences, as in the example.' Qiya: 'athletic, courageous, polite, creative, strong, imaginative, patient, careful'. 4 SURAT: 1 trapetsiyachi (sirk); 2 tennischi; 3 rassom (devoriy rasm chizyapti); 4 ofitsiant (smokingda). Qiya namuna: 'Trapeze artists ...have to be courageous and careful...' Tennis players ......; Artists ......; Waiters ......
4) 'Fill in: as, in, at or for.' 1 Do you think you're ready ...... your test yet? 2 ...... September, we're going to buy a new house. 3 Tim works ...... a gardener at the Hotel Royale. 4 ...... the moment, I'm still at school. 5 Rachel and Diana are studying History ...... university.
5) 'Underline the correct verb in bold.' 1 I'm a doctor, so I mustn't make/do mistakes at work. 2 The staff in this office practise/work very long hours. 3 We studied/learnt about sharks at school today. 4 When are you passing/taking your driving test? 5 I've got a job interview this morning, so wish/give me luck!

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '22'.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures, then use words from the list below to fill in the gaps: plumber, hairdresser, secretary, photographer, artist, carpenter. Pictures: a computer, b saw, c spanner, d palette and paintbrushes, e comb, f camera.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga qarang, so'ng quyidagi ro'yxatdagi so'zlar bilan bo'shliqlarni to'ldiring: plumber, hairdresser, secretary, photographer, artist, carpenter. Rasmlar: a kompyuter, b arra, c gayka kaliti, d palitra va mo'yqalamlar, e taroq, f fotoapparat.
exercises.explanationUz:
KASB va ASBOB (coursebook 34-bet
  1-mashq).

  secretary    - computer
  carpenter    - saw (arra)
  plumber      - spanner (kalit)
  artist       - palette,
                 paintbrushes
  hairdresser  - comb (taroq)
  photographer - camera


⚠ 'A(N)':

  unli bilan boshlansa 'AN':
  'AN artist'. Qolganlari 'A'.


⚠ 'A PLUMBER':

  = santexnik. /ˈplʌmə/ - 'b'
  O'QILMAYDI!


⚠ 'A CARPENTER':

  = duradgor.


⚠ 'A SPANNER':

  Brit. = gayka kaliti (AQSh
  'wrench').


⚠ 'A SAW':

  = arra. ('saw' - 'see' ning
  o'tgani ham!)


⚠ 'A PALETTE':

  = palitra (bo'yoq taxtasi).

items.sentence: d An ___ uses a palette and paintbrushes.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the jobs to the responsibilities, then make complete sentences, as in the example: A mechanic repairs cars.
exercises.instructionUz: Kasblarni vazifalarga moslang, so'ng to'liq gaplar tuzing, namunadagidek: A mechanic repairs cars.
exercises.explanationUz:
KASB va VAZIFA.

  QOLIP: A + KASB + FE'L-S + ...
  'A mechanic repairs cars.'


⚠ 'RESPONSIBILITIES':

  = vazifalar, mas'uliyatlar.


⚠ 'A CHEF':

  = oshpaz (restoran). /ʃef/ -
  fransuzcha.


⚠ 'A DISC JOCKEY' (DJ):

  = radio/klubda musiqa qo'yuvchi.


⚠ 'TO GROW CROPS':

  = ekin yetishtirmoq.
  'to raise animals' = chorva
  boqmoq.


⚠ 'A LEAKING TAP':

  = oqayotgan jo'mrak.
  'to fix' = tuzatmoq.


⚠ 'TO LOOK AFTER':

  = parvarish qilmoq, qaramoq.
  'a patient' = bemor.


⚠ 'TO DESIGN':

  = loyihalamoq. 'an architect' =
  me'mor. /ˈɑːkɪtekt/ - 'ch' = /k/!

exercises.instructionEn: Make complete sentences, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
QOLIP: A/An + KASB + FE'L-S.
  ⚠ 3-shaxs -S: repairs, grows,
  prepares, looks, plays, designs,
  fixES.
modelAnswers: A farmer grows crops and raises animals.
A chef prepares meals in a restaurant.
A nurse looks after patients in a hospital.
A disc jockey plays songs on the radio.
modelAnswersUz: Fermer ekin yetishtiradi va chorva boqadi.

exercises.instructionEn: Use adjectives from the list to make sentences, as in the example: athletic, courageous, polite, creative, strong, imaginative, patient, careful. 1 Trapeze artists 2 Tennis players 3 Artists 4 Waiters. Example: Trapeze artists have to be courageous and careful.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi sifatlar bilan gaplar tuzing, namunadagidek: athletic, courageous, polite, creative, strong, imaginative, patient, careful. 1 Trapetsiyachilar 2 Tennischilar 3 Rassomlar 4 Ofitsiantlar. Namuna: Trapetsiyachilar jasur va ehtiyotkor bo'lishlari kerak.
exercises.explanationUz:
KASB UChUN KERAKLI SIFATLAR
  (coursebook 34-bet 3-mashq).

  QOLIP: [KASB, ko'plik] have to be
  + SIFAT and SIFAT.
  ⚠ 'have to be' = bo'lishi kerak.

  Trapeze artists - courageous,
    careful (NAMUNA)
  Tennis players - athletic, strong
  Artists - creative, imaginative
  Waiters - polite, patient


⚠ 'COURAGEOUS':

  = jasur. /kəˈreɪdʒəs/. 'courage'
  = jasorat.


⚠ 'PATIENT' - IKKI MA'NO:

  1) sifat = sabrli
  2) ot = bemor (2-mashqda!)


⚠ 'A TRAPEZE ARTIST':

  = sirk trapetsiyachisi.


⚠ 'IMAGINATIVE':

  = tasavvurga boy.
  'CREATIVE' = ijodkor.
exercises.exampleEn: Trapeze artists have to be courageous and careful.
exercises.exampleUz: Trapetsiyachilar jasur va ehtiyotkor bo'lishlari kerak.
modelAnswers: Tennis players have to be athletic and strong.
Artists have to be creative and imaginative.
Waiters have to be polite and patient.
modelAnswersUz: Tennischilar atletik va kuchli bo'lishlari kerak.
Rassomlar ijodkor va tasavvurga boy bo'lishlari kerak.
Ofitsiantlar odobli va sabrli bo'lishlari kerak.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in: as, in, at or for.
exercises.instructionUz: Qo'ying: as, in, at yoki for.
exercises.explanationUz:
PREDLOGLAR (coursebook 35-bet
  10-mashq).

  ready FOR      - ... ga tayyor
  IN September   - oy oldidan 'in'
  work AS        - ... bo'lib
    ishlamoq (kasb)
  AT the moment  - hozir
  AT university  - universitetda


⚠ 'WORK AS' vs 'WORK AT':

  work AS a gardener (KASB)
  work AT the Hotel Royale (JOY)
  ⚠ 3-gapda IKKALASI ham bor!


⚠ 'AT SCHOOL / AT UNIVERSITY':

  = maktabda / universitetda
  o'qimoq (artiklsiz).


⚠ 'YET':

  = hali (so'roqda).

items.sentence: Do you think you're ready ___ your test yet?
___ September, we're going to buy a new house.
items.uz: Sentyabrda biz yangi uy sotib olmoqchimiz.

items.sentence: Tim works ___ a gardener at the Hotel Royale.
items.uz: Tim Royale mehmonxonasida bog'bon bo'lib ishlaydi.

items.sentence: ___ the moment, I'm still at school.
Rachel and Diana are studying History ___ university.
items.uz: Reychel va Diana universitetda tarix o'qishyapti.

exercises.instructionEn: Underline the correct verb in bold.
exercises.instructionUz: Qalin harfli to'g'ri fe'lning tagiga chizing.
exercises.explanationUz:
TURG'UN BIRIKMALAR (coursebook
  35-bet 8-9-mashqlar).

  MAKE mistakes  - xato qilmoq
    ('do mistakes' - XATO!)
  WORK long hours - ko'p soat
    ishlamoq
  LEARN about    - ... haqida
    o'rganmoq
  TAKE a test    - imtihon
    topshirmoq
    ('pass' = muvaffaqiyatli
    o'tmoq - natija)
  WISH sb luck   - omad tilamoq


⚠ 'TAKE' vs 'PASS':

  take a test = imtihonga kirmoq
  pass a test = imtihondan o'tmoq
  'When are you TAKING' - qachon
  kirasan.


⚠ 'STUDY' vs 'LEARN':

  study = o'qimoq (jarayon)
  learn about = bilib olmoq
  'learnt about sharks' - akulalar
  haqida bilib oldik.
  ⚠ 'learnt' (Brit.) / 'learned'
  (AQSh).


⚠ 'A JOB INTERVIEW':

  = ishga suhbat.
